Specification: This module defines a trace-generation and visualization wrapper around an underlying EWD998ChanID specification. It customizes the initial condition to reduce the number of generated initial states, adds a bounded trace-generation invariant using TLC's current search level, and defines helper operators for extracting a host identifier and producing a JSON-like alias record for ShiViz-style log visualization. The module does not define the core algorithm itself; instead, it relies on the extended base module for the protocol state variables and behavior, while this file focuses on initialization constraints, finite-prefix exploration, and trace post-processing helpers.
